source.title: Forebears Central African Republic forenames and surnames frequency tables

names.notes: Public frequency tables were used to seed localized given names and surnames. The source is not an official civil registry export; gender buckets are review seeds based on public usage.

source.title: ITU Central African Republic numbering plan communication

phones.notes: ITU material confirms country code +236, eight-digit national numbering, and mobile ranges including 70, 72, 75 and 77. Generated numbers are synthetic and are not checked for live assignment or portability.

source.title: UPU General Addressing Issues: countries without postcode requirement

locations.notes: UPU lists Central African Republic among countries that do not require postal codes. The dataset uses BP-style generator prefixes; province/city links follow public geography, while street names and generated box numbers remain synthetic review data.

national_identity_card_number.label: National Identity Card

source.title: Central African Republic Embassy passport requirements

national_identity_card_number.notes: Embassy passport requirements list the Carte Nationale d'Identite as an identity document. No public official number grammar, checksum or semantic digit rule was found; generated values are synthetic placeholders.

passport.label: Passport

source.title: PRADO Central African Republic document country page

passport.notes: PRADO confirms Central African Republic travel/identity document coverage, but no public passport-number grammar was confirmed. The template remains synthetic.
